# BLO-48361 — re-expose the pre-push hook dir on narrowed runs

`src/server/job-manifest.ts`: `ROOT_TOOLCHAIN_SUBPATHS` gains
`.local/share/paperclip-git-hooks`, bound read-only like the rest of the
allowlist. Phase 2b (BLO-32734) overlaid the PVC root and omitted it, so on
every narrowed run the image `git` wrapper's core.hooksPath held no hook and
the PEN-3156 egress guard refused every push. Only that dir is exposed; the
rest of `.local/share` (mkcert's CA key) stays behind the overlay.

Test: `src/server/job-manifest.git-hooks.test.ts` builds a narrowed manifest and
checks both the main and init containers: `.local/share/paperclip-git-hooks/pre-push`
resolves to read-only `data`, and `.local/share/mkcert/rootCA-key.pem` still
resolves to `root-overlay`. It fails with the allowlist entry removed and with
it widened to `.local/share`.
